'''catman421 Hidden Base With A-wings (HB) (V1)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[catman421]]
* '''Published:''' 28 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 HB catman421 LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Just a basic hidden base deck that uses A-wings to force drain along with other powerful starships.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Use haven to get ships to deploy cheaply closer to other systems.  Use Concentrate All Fire boost power in battles.  Also use special edition x-wings for the added destiny.
